university-of-pennsylvania.label: Penn Admissions
evidence: Penn applicants are required to submit scores for the SAT or ACT. Applicants who face hardship in meeting this requirement can submit a waiver instead.

ohio-state-university.label: Ohio State admissions
evidence: Yes, standardized test scores from ACT or SAT are required for first-year applicants to the Columbus campus.
applicants who will have been out of high school for two or more years by their term of enrollment are not required to submit scores
ohio-state-university.note: Columbus campus. Applicants two or more years out of high school aren't required to submit scores. Regional campuses have their own application pages.

williams-college.label: Williams admission
